zh: 谢谢你帮我修改报告。
old_en: Thanks for helping me revise the report.
new_en: Thanks for helping me fix the report.

zh: 谢谢你帮我收快递。
old_en: Thanks for helping me with the delivery.
new_en: Thanks for getting my delivery for me.

zh: 谢谢你帮我打印文档。
old_en: Thanks for printing the document for me.
new_en: Thanks for printing the document for me.

zh: 谢谢你借我这本书。
old_en: Thanks for lending me this book.
new_en: Thanks for lending me this book.

zh: 这本书帮了我大忙，谢谢你。
old_en: This book really helped me, thanks.
new_en: This book really helped me, thanks a lot.

zh: 谢谢你等我这么长时间。
old_en: Thanks for waiting for me for so long.
new_en: Thanks for waiting for me for such a long time.

zh: 你帮我改好了报告，真感谢你。
old_en: I appreciate it so much that you helped me revise the report.
new_en: You really helped me fix the report, thanks a lot.

zh: 谢谢你帮我拿行李。
old_en: You're welcome for helping me with my luggage.
new_en: Thanks for helping me with my luggage.

zh: 你帮我拿行李了，真感谢。
old_en: You're welcome, I really appreciate you helping me with my luggage.
new_en: Thanks for helping me with my luggage, I really appreciate it.

zh: 谢谢你帮我打扫房间。
old_en: I appreciate it when you help me clean the room.
new_en: Thanks for cleaning my room.

zh: 你帮我打扫房间了，真感谢。
old_en: You're welcome, I appreciate it when you help me clean the room.
new_en: Thanks for cleaning my room, I really appreciate it.

zh: 你帮我收了快递，真感谢。
old_en: You're welcome to help me with the delivery.
new_en: Thanks for picking up my delivery, I really appreciate it.

zh: 谢谢你耐心地给我讲解。
old_en: I appreciate it when you patiently explained it to me.
new_en: Thanks for explaining it to me patiently.

zh: 谢谢你帮我找尺码，真合适。
old_en: Thanks for helping me find the right size; it fits perfectly.
new_en: Thanks for helping me find the right size; it fits perfectly.

zh: 你帮我找到了合适的尺码，真的感谢。
old_en: Thanks for helping me find the right size.
new_en: Thanks for finding the right size for me, I really appreciate it.

zh: 你帮我打印好了文档，真感谢。
old_en: I appreciate it so much that you helped me print the document.
new_en: Thanks for printing the document for me, I really appreciate it.

zh: 你今天等我真是太好了，真感谢。
old_en: You're welcome, coming to pick me up today really made my day.
new_en: Thanks for waiting for me today, it really means a lot to me.

zh: 谢谢你做了这顿饭。
old_en: I appreciate it that you cooked this meal.
new_en: Thanks for cooking this meal.

zh: 这顿饭做得真好，谢谢你。
old_en: Thanks for the nice meal.
new_en: The meal was really delicious, thanks a lot.

zh: 你耐心给我解释，我真的很感谢。
old_en: You patiently explained it to me, and I really appreciate it.
new_en: Thanks for explaining it to me so patiently.
